cases.title: a completed message
cases.notes: The baseline parse. Pins the whole result shape in one row: text lifted from the LAST output item's first content part, the finish reason, the usage arithmetic, the meta block, and the message list with the assistant turn appended. Every user message in this suite carries a non-empty additionalAttributes on purpose — see trs-0006 for why.

cases.title: cached input tokens are subtracted from the prompt count
cases.notes: prompt_tokens is input_tokens MINUS the cached count, and the cached count is also reported separately. A port that passes input_tokens straight through double-counts the cache on every prompt-cached request and silently inflates the caller's cost reporting. Exact integers, no tolerance.

cases.title: content filter
cases.notes: An incomplete response whose reason is a content filter maps to its own finish reason rather than to length — and length is the branch that THROWS, so getting this wrong turns a filtered answer into an exception. Pins that the top-level status is inspected before the per-item status.

cases.title: empty output array
cases.notes: The last-element lookup on an empty list yields nothing, so the text is the empty string and the finish reason falls through to unknown rather than throwing. A port that indexes the last element without guarding crashes on a response the provider is entitled to send.

cases.title: reasoning summaries are collected across output items
cases.notes: Reasoning items are flattened into a list of summary texts on the result's additional content, and the message text still comes from the LAST item — which is the message, not the reasoning. Pins both the collection and the fact that a reasoning item does not become the answer.

cases.title: a user message with no additional attributes
cases.notes: The one row in this suite that leaves additionalAttributes empty. It was isolated here because the reference rendered an empty map as an empty JSON ARRAY — PHP has one array type, so the field changed JSON type with its contents — and no port could reproduce that without modelling maps as arrays. The reference now wraps its map-typed fields, so the row is enforced in all three languages and this is the row that would notice if it stopped being. Finding F-3, serialise half, closed. The DECODE half of F-3 is not closed and cannot be: see jci-0001.

cases.title: service tier absent from the response
cases.notes: A field the provider may omit becomes an explicit null on the parsed result rather than vanishing from it. Pins the absent-to-null direction, which is the mirror of trq-0001 and the half a port is most likely to get wrong in the language where absent and null are different values.
